set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: O03.6
Accountable role (person unassigned): Recovery/backend engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Extract the reusable witness and PostgreSQL adapter from O03.2 so all currently implemented authority can recover before browser identity is implemented. O03.2 retains complete identity/guest/session integration acceptance.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Enumerate every authority-changing entry point in the current build: principal state, lab/project state, memberships and expiry, placement/custody, stewardship, independent and release-scoped grants, API credential issue/revocation and affected leases. Each supported mutation has an exact versioned event and atomic local policy/event/receipt commit; no supported write path bypasses the journal.
2. Implement ADR004 using a separately permissioned service/store and independently retained trust bundle, authenticated transport, canonical signed records, contiguous journal order and installation/epoch binding. Fenced enrollment imports complete existing authority and tombstones, preserving all pre-enrollment restrictions; an empty witness or restored primary cannot establish currency.
3. Durably PREPARE the complete event before local commit, obtain verified remote COMMIT before completed success, and resolve retries by operation ID plus exact payload. An outage, lost response or unresolved intent cannot be reported as durable success or overtaken; restrictions already committed locally remain effective. Lost primary plus unresolved PREPARE leaves recovery closed as ADR004 requires.
4. Implement fresh current-head challenges, durable recovery barriers and writer fencing. Startup and runtime admission reject stale epochs/heads, with permits at most five seconds and bounded drain; changing only a restored database epoch cannot fence an old writer. Preserve current per-operation authorization checks.
5. Expose a versioned supported-capability/event inventory and redacted durability/readiness diagnostics. Unsupported policy kinds or capability versions fail closed; adding identity/session/lifecycle producers requires explicit enrollment/upgrade integration, never silent omission. Keep legacy organization recovery blocked.
6. Exercise real independent connections/stores and process restarts at every prepare/local-commit/remote-commit/receipt boundary; verify exact retries, changed-payload rejection, duplicate/reordered events, gaps, foreign installation, tampering, key trust and stale-writer rejection. Local service separation claims component isolation only, not computer/disk-loss durability.

Verification: Executable witness/SQL fault matrix, signing/canonicalization vectors, complete mutation-to-event inventory and source-bound receipts from real separate services; protocol-model results alone cannot close this task.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.6/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresOrganizationCatalog.scala
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/RecoveryCli.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh

Blocked by:
- O03.1: bd-01M4W5P9194RGNP7DFGHB7ZK09
- F03.2: bd-01M4W5P5GCCHC6ZMZ7MCGEJCW8

User-approved recovery priority, 14 October 2026. Current-capability recovery precedes browser expansion; full identity/session/lifecycle and institutional qualification remain mandatory.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
set.title: O03.6: Implement independent policy durability for the current catalog
